target: single final arbiter for actual 30s holding horizon

rules.conflict: wait when selected projection and terminal structure disagree
rules.trend: same direction as 90s fit and recent leg
rules.oscillation: only an already-confirmed structural turn aligned with recent leg

acceptance.eachExternalCohort: strictly improved accuracy, positive illustrative net at 86% payout, coverage at least 25%, no worse maximum loss streak
acceptance.native: report separately; signed sample and OCR video do not establish independent live profitability

stop: reject at first failing complete external development cohort; do not tune thresholds or consume untouched holdout
preservation: no waiting timer or fixed new candle count
